name: @BLANK
semantics: True when the value is blank under the upstream Type/source blank-handling rules (user-defined missing, optionally null/whitespace).

name: @NULL
semantics: True only for system-missing ($null$); false for user-defined blanks. The only function that does not propagate null.

name: is_date
semantics: True if the value has date storage.

name: is_datetime
semantics: True if the value has date, time or timestamp storage.

name: is_integer
semantics: True if the value has integer storage.

name: is_number
semantics: True if the value has numeric (integer or real) storage.

name: is_real
semantics: True if the value has real storage.

name: is_string
semantics: True if the value has string storage.

name: is_time
semantics: True if the value has time storage.

name: is_timestamp
semantics: True if the value has timestamp storage.

name: undef
semantics: Constant that yields the system-missing value ($null$); used as in "if Age > 30 then undef else Age endif".
Concatenation; result is always a string even for non-string operands (3 >< 5 gives "35").

name: to_integer
semantics: Convert storage to integer.

name: to_real
semantics: Convert storage to real.

name: to_number
semantics: Convert storage to a number (integer or real as the value dictates).

name: to_string
semantics: Convert to string; a real is rendered with 6 digits after the decimal point.

name: to_time
semantics: Convert to time using the stream time format when the input is a string.

name: to_date
semantics: Convert to date; strings are parsed with the stream date format and must match it.

name: to_timestamp
semantics: Convert to timestamp.

name: to_datetime
semantics: Convert to a date, time or timestamp value, whichever fits the input.

name: datetime_date
semantics: Date from a number (seconds since baseline; fraction of a day truncated), a string (parsed with date format), or a timestamp (date part); a date is returned unchanged.

name: stb_centroid_latitude
semantics: Latitude of the centroid of a geohash argument (documented as an integer).

name: stb_centroid_longitude
semantics: Longitude of the centroid of a geohash argument (documented as an integer).

name: to_geohash
semantics: Geohash string; one character per 5 bits, bits in 1..75. IBM lists the ranges of latitude and longitude swapped (-180..180 vs -90..90); treat as a documentation error.

name: count_equal
semantics: Count of listed fields equal to ITEM1; null if ITEM1 is null.

name: count_greater_than
semantics: Count of listed fields greater than ITEM1; null if ITEM1 is null.

name: count_less_than
semantics: Count of listed fields less than ITEM1; null if ITEM1 is null.

name: count_not_equal
semantics: Count of listed fields not equal to ITEM1; null if ITEM1 is null.

name: count_nulls
semantics: Count of null values among the listed fields.

name: count_non_nulls
semantics: Count of non-null values among the listed fields.

name: date_before
semantics: True if DATE1 is before DATE2 (dates or timestamps); otherwise false.

name: first_index
semantics: 1-based index of the first listed field containing ITEM, or 0 if none; string, integer and real only.

name: first_non_null
semantics: First non-null value in the listed fields.

name: first_non_null_index
semantics: 1-based index of the first non-null listed field, or 0 if all are null.

name: last_index
semantics: 1-based index of the last listed field containing ITEM, or 0 if none; string, integer and real only.

name: last_non_null
semantics: Last non-null value in the listed fields.

name: last_non_null_index
semantics: 1-based index of the last non-null listed field, or 0 if all are null.

name: max
semantics: Greater of two items.

name: min
semantics: Lesser of two items.

name: max_index
semantics: 1-based index of the field holding the maximum (leftmost on ties); 0 if all null.

name: min_index
semantics: 1-based index of the field holding the minimum (leftmost on ties); 0 if all null.

name: max_n
semantics: Maximum over listed numeric fields; null if all are null.

name: min_n
semantics: Minimum over listed numeric fields; null if all are null.

name: member
semantics: True if ITEM is in LIST (a list of field names is allowed).

name: time_before
semantics: True if TIME1 is before TIME2.

name: value_at
semantics: Value of the INTth listed field (1-based); null when INT is outside 1..length.
Equality; same as ==.
Equality; identical to =.
Inequality; identical to /==.
Inequality; identical to /=.
Strictly less than.
Less than or equal.
Strictly greater than.
Greater than or equal.

name: and
semantics: Conjunction with short-circuit (COND2 not evaluated when COND1 is false); three-valued with null.

name: or
semantics: Inclusive disjunction with short-circuit (COND2 not evaluated when COND1 is true); three-valued with null.

name: not
semantics: Negation; not(null) is null.

name: if-then-else-endif
arguments: if COND then EXPR1 else EXPR2 endif
semantics: Conditional; a null condition takes the else branch.

name: if-then-elseif-else-endif
arguments: if COND1 then EXPR1 elseif COND2 then EXPR2 else EXPR_N endif
semantics: Multi-branch conditional.

name: - (unary)
semantics: Negation; same as negate.
Sum.

name: - (binary)
semantics: Difference.
Product.
Quotient; division by zero yields null (see chapter on missing values).

name: div
semantics: Integer division.

name: rem
semantics: Remainder: INT1 - (INT1 div INT2) * INT2.

name: mod
semantics: Deprecated; use rem.
Power; integer POWER uses repeated multiplication so integer BASE gives integer; integer 0 power gives 1 of BASE's type; otherwise exp(POWER*log(BASE)).

name: abs
semantics: Absolute value, same type as input.

name: exp
semantics: e raised to NUM.

name: fracof
semantics: Fractional part: NUM - intof(NUM).

name: intof
semantics: Truncate toward zero.

name: log
semantics: Natural logarithm; argument must not be zero.

name: log10
semantics: Base-10 logarithm, log(NUM)/log(10); argument must not be zero.

name: negate
semantics: Opposite sign.

name: round
semantics: Round half away from zero: intof(NUM+0.5) if positive, intof(NUM-0.5) if negative.

name: sign
semantics: -1, 0 or 1 (integer input) or -1.0, 0.0, 1.0 (real input).

name: sqrt
semantics: Square root; negative input gives null.

name: sum_n
semantics: Sum of listed numeric fields; null if all are null.

name: mean_n
semantics: Mean of listed numeric fields; null if all are null.

name: sdev_n
semantics: Standard deviation of listed numeric fields; null if all are null (sample vs population not documented).

name: arccos
semantics: Arc cosine; result unit follows the stream angle setting.

name: arccosh
semantics: Hyperbolic arc cosine.

name: arcsin
semantics: Arc sine; unit follows stream setting.

name: arcsinh
semantics: Hyperbolic arc sine.

name: arctan
semantics: Arc tangent; unit follows stream setting.

name: arctan2
semantics: Quadrant-aware arc tangent of Y/X in (-pi, pi] or (-180, 180] degrees.

name: arctanh
semantics: Hyperbolic arc tangent.

name: cos
semantics: Cosine; argument unit follows stream setting (radians or degrees).

name: cosh
semantics: Hyperbolic cosine.

name: pi
semantics: The constant pi.

name: sin
semantics: Sine; argument unit follows stream setting.

name: sinh
semantics: Hyperbolic sine.

name: tan
semantics: Tangent; argument unit follows stream setting.

name: tanh
semantics: Hyperbolic tangent.

name: cdf_chisq
semantics: P(X < NUM) for chi-square with DF degrees of freedom.

name: cdf_f
semantics: P(X < NUM) for the F distribution.

name: cdf_normal
semantics: P(X < NUM) for the normal distribution.

name: cdf_t
semantics: P(X < NUM) for Student's t with DF degrees of freedom.

name: close_to
semantics: True if two shapes are within the given distance (metres for a projected system, arbitrary units otherwise).

name: crosses
semantics: True if two shapes cross (two linestrings, or a linestring and a polygon).

name: overlap
semantics: True if two polygons intersect and the intersection is interior to both.

name: within
semantics: True if the first shape lies entirely inside the polygon.

name: area
semantics: Area of a POLYGON or MULTIPOLYGON (square metres if projected).

name: num_points
semantics: Count of points of a MULTIPOINT inside a POLYGON/MULTIPOLYGON (second argument form is unclear in the docs).

name: distance
semantics: Distance between two shapes of any geo measurement type.
Bitwise complement; equals -(INT+1).
Bitwise inclusive or.
Bitwise exclusive or.
Bitwise and.
Bitwise and with complement of INT2 (clears bits).
Shift left by N; negative N shifts right.
Shift right by N; negative N shifts left (sign-extended).
True when (INT1 && INT2) = 0.
True when (INT1 && INT2) is not 0.

name: integer_bitcount
semantics: Number of 1 bits (non-negative INT) or 0 bits (negative INT) in two's complement.

name: integer_leastbit
semantics: Position of the least significant set bit.

name: integer_length
semantics: Smallest N with INT < (1<<N) (INT>=0) or INT >= (-1<<N) (INT<0).

name: testbit
semantics: True if bit N (0-based, weight 2**N) of INT is 1.

name: oneof
semantics: Randomly chosen element of the list (list of field names allowed).

name: random
semantics: Uniform random in 1..NUM of the same type as NUM; may equal NUM.

name: random0
semantics: Like random but from 0 and never equal to NUM.

name: allbutfirst
semantics: STRING without its first N characters.

name: allbutlast
semantics: STRING without its last N characters.

name: alphabefore
semantics: True if STRING1 sorts before STRING2.

name: count_substring
semantics: Number of occurrences of SUBSTRING (count_substring("foooo.txt","oo") is 3: overlapping matches are counted).

name: endstring
semantics: Last LENGTH characters; unchanged if STRING is not longer.

name: hasendstring
semantics: Same as isendstring(SUBSTRING, STRING).

name: hasmidstring
semantics: Same as ismidstring(SUBSTRING, STRING).

name: hasstartstring
semantics: Same as isstartstring(SUBSTRING, STRING).

name: hassubstring
semantics: Same as issubstring(SUBSTRING, N, STRING); N defaults to 1.

name: isalphacode
semantics: True if the character is a letter.

name: isendstring
semantics: 1-based subscript of SUBSTRING if STRING ends with it, else 0.

name: islowercode
semantics: True if the character is lower case.

name: ismidstring
semantics: Start subscript if SUBSTRING occurs strictly inside STRING (not at the start or end), else 0.

name: isnumbercode
semantics: True if the character is a digit.

name: isstartstring
semantics: 1 if STRING starts with SUBSTRING, else 0.

name: issubstring
semantics: 1-based start subscript of the first match at or after position N (default 1), else 0.

name: issubstring_count
semantics: Start subscript of the Nth occurrence of SUBSTRING, or 0 if there are fewer.

name: issubstring_lim
semantics: issubstring with the match required to start by STARTLIM and end by ENDLIM; false disables a limit.

name: isuppercode
semantics: True if the character is upper case.

name: last
semantics: Last character of STRING (must have at least one character).

name: length
semantics: Number of characters.

name: locchar
semantics: 1-based position of CHAR searching forward from position N; 0 if absent; null if N is an invalid offset.

name: locchar_back
semantics: Like locchar but searches backward from position N; null on invalid offset.

name: lowertoupper
semantics: Upper-case conversion; result has the same kind as the input.

name: matches
semantics: Wildcard match: ? is one character, * is zero or more, backslash escapes them; PATTERN must be a literal.

name: replace
semantics: Replace every occurrence of SUBSTRING.

name: replicate
semantics: STRING repeated COUNT times.

name: stripchar
semantics: Remove all occurrences of CHAR from STRING.

name: skipchar
semantics: Position of the first character at or after N that is not CHAR; 0 if all are CHAR; null on invalid offset.

name: skipchar_back
semantics: Like skipchar but searches backward from N.

name: startstring
semantics: First LENGTH characters; unchanged if STRING is not longer.

name: strmember
semantics: Same as locchar(CHAR, 1, STRING).

name: subscrs
semantics: Nth character (1-based); also written STRING(N); out-of-range index is undefined behaviour.

name: substring
semantics: LEN characters starting at 1-based position N.

name: substring_between
semantics: Characters from position N1 through N2 (1-based; inclusivity of N2 is assumed from "begins at N1 and ends at N2").

name: trim
semantics: Remove leading and trailing white space.

name: trim_start
semantics: Remove leading white space (the narrative also calls it trimstart).

name: trimend
semantics: Remove trailing white space.

name: unicode_char
semantics: Character for a decimal Unicode code point.

name: unicode_value
semantics: Unicode code point of a character.

name: uppertolower
semantics: Lower-case conversion; result has the same kind as the input.

name: soundex
semantics: Four-character SoundEx code (documented as Integer but a code string is described; likely String).

name: soundex_difference
semantics: Similarity of SoundEx codes, 0 (none) to 4 (identical).

name: @TODAY
semantics: Current date as a string in the stream date format; null for two-digit formats without Rollover days/mins.

name: date_add_years
semantics: Add NUM years to a date or timestamp.

name: date_add_months
semantics: Add NUM months.

name: date_add_weeks
semantics: Add NUM weeks.

name: date_add_days
semantics: Add NUM days.

name: date_days_difference
semantics: Days from DATE1 to DATE2; negative if DATE2 is earlier.

name: date_in_days
semantics: Days from the baseline date; negative before baseline.

name: date_in_months
semantics: Months from baseline, approximated with a 30.4375-day month (an introductory page says 30.0).

name: date_in_weeks
semantics: Weeks from baseline (7.0-day week).

name: date_in_years
semantics: Years from baseline, 365.25-day year.

name: date_months_difference
semantics: Months from DATE1 to DATE2 (30.4375-day month); negative if DATE2 earlier.

name: date_weeks_difference
semantics: Weeks from DATE1 to DATE2 (7.0-day week).

name: date_years_difference
semantics: Years from DATE1 to DATE2 (365.25-day year).

name: datetime_day
semantics: Day of month 1..31.

name: datetime_day_name
semantics: Full weekday name for integer 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday).

name: datetime_day_short_name
semantics: Abbreviated weekday name for 1 (Sunday) to 7 (Saturday).

name: datetime_hour
semantics: Hour 0..23.

name: datetime_in_seconds
semantics: Seconds in a time, or seconds elapsed since the 1900-01-01 baseline for a date or datetime.

name: datetime_minute
semantics: Minute 0..59.

name: datetime_month
semantics: Month 1..12.

name: datetime_month_name
semantics: Full month name for 1..12.

name: datetime_month_short_name
semantics: Abbreviated month name for 1..12.

name: datetime_now
semantics: Current time; time zone follows the stream Time zone option.

name: datetime_second
semantics: Second 0..59.

name: datetime_time
semantics: Build a time from integer parts, or take the time value of ITEM.

name: datetime_timestamp
arguments: YEAR, MONTH, DAY, HOUR, MINUTE, SECOND or DATE, TIME or NUMBER
semantics: Build a timestamp from six parts, from date plus time, or from a number of seconds.

name: datetime_weekday
semantics: Day of week (numbering not stated; day-name functions imply 1=Sunday).

name: datetime_year
semantics: Year, e.g. 2002.

name: date_from_ywd
semantics: Date from ISO 8601 year, week and weekday (documented result type Integer).

name: date_iso_day
semantics: ISO 8601 day of week.

name: date_iso_week
semantics: ISO 8601 week of year.

name: date_iso_year
semantics: ISO 8601 year.

name: time_add_hours
semantics: Add NUM hours (the 19.0 table prints Date for the first form, evidently a typo).

name: time_add_minutes
semantics: Add NUM minutes.

name: time_add_seconds
semantics: Add NUM seconds.

name: time_hours_difference
semantics: Hours from TIME1 to TIME2; with Rollover a higher TIME1 means the previous day, else the result is negative.

name: time_in_hours
semantics: Time as hours (HHMM "0130" gives 1.5).

name: time_in_mins
semantics: Time as minutes.

name: time_in_secs
semantics: Time as seconds.

name: time_mins_difference
semantics: Minutes from TIME1 to TIME2 with the same rollover rule.

name: time_secs_difference
semantics: Seconds from TIME1 to TIME2 with the same rollover rule.

name: @MEAN
semantics: Running mean over all records so far, or the last EXPR records including the current one; INT caps lookback storage.

name: @SUM
semantics: Running sum, optionally over the last EXPR records.

name: @MIN
semantics: Running minimum, optionally over the last EXPR records.

name: @MAX
semantics: Running maximum, optionally over the last EXPR records.

name: @SDEV
semantics: Running standard deviation, optionally over the last EXPR records.

name: @DIFF1
semantics: First difference vs previous record (null if none); two-argument form is @DIFF1(F1)/@DIFF1(F2).

name: @DIFF2
semantics: Second difference; two-argument form per the long formula in the guide.

name: @INDEX
semantics: 1-based index of the current record at this node.

name: @LAST_NON_BLANK
semantics: Last non-blank value so far; null if none.

name: @OFFSET
semantics: Value of FIELD EXPR records back (positive) or ahead (negative, constant only); null/error rules for self-reference documented in the guide.

name: @SINCE
semantics: Records since EXPR was last true, excluding the current record; @INDEX+1 if never.

name: @SINCE0
semantics: Like @SINCE but includes the current record (0 if true now).

name: @THIS
semantics: Current record's value of FIELD; only valid inside @SINCE expressions.

name: @GLOBAL_MAX
semantics: Whole-data-set maximum from a Set Globals node; error if not set.

name: @GLOBAL_MIN
semantics: Whole-data-set minimum; error if not set.

name: @GLOBAL_SDEV
semantics: Whole-data-set standard deviation; error if not set.

name: @GLOBAL_MEAN
semantics: Whole-data-set mean; error if not set.

name: @GLOBAL_SUM
semantics: Whole-data-set sum; error if not set.

name: @FIELD
semantics: Stands for each selected field in multi-field Derive and Filler nodes.

name: @TARGET
semantics: Target field value in a user-defined Analysis expression.

name: @PREDICTED
semantics: Predicted value in a user-defined Analysis expression.

name: @PARTITION_FIELD
semantics: The current partition field.

name: @TRAINING_PARTITION
semantics: The value that denotes the training partition.

name: @TESTING_PARTITION
semantics: The value that denotes the testing partition.

name: @VALIDATION_PARTITION
semantics: The value that denotes the validation partition.

name: @FIELDS_BETWEEN
semantics: Field names between two fields inclusive in natural field order.

name: @FIELDS_MATCHING
semantics: Field names matching a literal wildcard pattern (? and *, backslash escape).

name: @MULTI_RESPONSE_SET
semantics: Fields of a named multiple response set.

name: datetime_date
semantics: Date from integer year, month and day.
